notes: Webhook delivers full order state as JSON via POST. Verify signature using X-Shopify-Hmac-SHA256 header with app shared secret. Respond with 2xx quickly; process asynchronously. Deduplicate using X-Shopify-Webhook-Id header. Topic for paid orders is not explicitly shown but inferred from context as orders/updated when payment captures. Payload includes label (order number), totals array (use type: total for total price), and customer email must be extracted from elsewhere in full order schema (not shown in example but assumed present per plan).

Create up to 10 records per request. Requires Bearer token auth via Authorization header. Base ID and table ID/name are path parameters. Response includes created record IDs and timestamps. No pagination for create operation. Ensure Airtable has columns 'Order Number' (text), 'Customer Email' (email), and 'Total' (number/currency). Total from Shopify is in cents (integer) - convert to dollars by dividing by 100.0.
